en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a street scene with a large ancient triumphal arch spanning a cobbled road. A tram runs on tracks beneath the arch, with several pedestrians around it; a uniformed boy or young man stands in the foreground. Surrounding the arch are early 20th‑century buildings. Greek and French captions are printed beneath the image, along with a faint round stamp mark.
